role: Registers the sword recipes (one per tier material), the bow and the arrow recipes into the CraftingManager.
scope_reason: Swords and arrows are combat core; no world.conf switch touches them. The bow is craftable even though fishing (its string source) is off.

members.name: RecipesWeapons
members.note: The recipePatterns and recipeItems tables exist only to feed addRecipes; the native side has the emitted recipes.

members.name: recipePatterns
members.note: The sword column pattern, the bow and the arrow pattern land as recipe_def width/height plus ingredient runs.

members.name: addRecipes
members.note: Registration is mirrored by csrc/engine/recipes.h:RECIPES, generated by netherite.oracle.RecipeTable from the oracle's live CraftingManager.getRecipeList() in list order.

notes: The bow and arrow recipes are plain shaped recipes in the generated table, so they need no special-casing. Did not verify which RECIPES indices are the bow and arrow rows; the crafting probe covers the whole list.
